title: Key Vault grant token claims
description: Claims of an Identity-issued key-vault grant. Verbatim from AUTH-KEY-LIFECYCLE-INSTRUCTIONS-v2 Appendix B.3; this file is now the authoritative home and that appendix is a reference to it. Enforcement semantics are INV-017.

aud.description: Scalar only. An array is refused even if it contains this value (INV-015).

sub.description: accountRef. Must equal {accountRef} in the request path — fail closed on mismatch.

jti.description: Single-use for destructive operations; the Key Vault persists consumed values until exp.

nbf.description: Seconds since epoch. REQUIRED per INV-017 (valid iat/nbf/exp). Appendix B.3's claim list omits nbf; the owner ruling of 2026-09-05 is newer and governs. See the README.

exp.description: Seconds since epoch. Destructive operations: exp - iat <= 300.

op.description: Exactly one operation. Must match the route exactly.

generation.description: Required exactly for manifest-generation-recover; same-generation for manifest-provisioning-replace.

txId.description: Required for manifest-rotate. Identity writes the durable PREPARED record BEFORE issuing the grant, so every txId the Vault sees is classifiable.
